test_title: PYST 9: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
A sentence is provided in indirect speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding direct speech:

The analyst commented that had the model incorporated volatility, projections would have been accurate.

options.text: "Had the model incorporated volatility, projections would have been accurate," commented the analyst.
"Projections can never be accurate," said the analyst.
"Why use volatility in models at all?" asked the analyst.
"We removed volatility to simplify projections," said the analyst.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The analyst commented that had the model incorporated volatility, projections would have been accurate.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"had the model incorporated volatility" remains "Had the model incorporated volatility"**
 
 
• The conditional clause in indirect speech is retained in direct speech without changes.
 
 
 
• **"projections would have been accurate" remains "projections would have been accurate"**
 
 
• The outcome clause remains identical as it reflects the hypothetical scenario.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "commented"
 
• Converted to: "commented," as it is directly linked to the analyst’s statement.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "Had" and ends with a comma before the reporting clause.
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Had the model incorporated volatility, projections would have been accurate," commented the analyst.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "Projections can never be accurate," said the analyst.
 
 
• Changes the meaning entirely by stating a negation rather than a conditional hypothetical.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Why use volatility in models at all?" asked the analyst.
 
 
• Does not relate to the original indirect speech, as it introduces a question that was not implied.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "We removed volatility to simplify projections," said the analyst.
 
 
• Incorrect context, as the original sentence does not mention removal of volatility.
